landing.headline: Get paid for views a campaign actually counts.
landing.sub: Merchants publish campaigns with a written rate, a cap and a deadline. Creators post, the qualified views are metered, and every claim is reviewed before it is paid.
landing.signInNote: This demo has no other way in: no email, no password, no one-time code.
landing.pointRate: A written rate per 1,000 qualified views
landing.pointCap: A cap per submission, so the ceiling is known before you post
landing.pointReview: Review, appeal and a traceable payout record
landing.metaDescription: Browse content-reward campaigns with a written rate per 1,000 qualified views, a cap per submission and a claim deadline. Prototype with simulated data.
landing.demoGuideNote: The guided demo lists the main flow in order and every exception scenario, and switches to the right simulated role for each step.

catalogue.title: Campaigns
catalogue.subtitle: Published campaigns anyone can read before signing in.
catalogue.metaDescription: Published content-reward campaigns with rate, cap, minimum claim and submission deadline.
catalogue.emptyDescription: Nothing is published in this demo right now. Load a scenario from the demo tools to see one.

campaign.minClaimNote: This is the smallest new amount one claim can be. It is not a wallet balance threshold.
campaign.capNote: Cumulative ceiling for one post, across the whole campaign.
campaign.viewThresholdNote: Both the threshold and the minimum claim must be met. Reaching the threshold does not raise the cap.
campaign.meteringValue: {days} days after your post is accepted
campaign.retentionValue: {days} days after publish, extended by open cases
campaign.joinSignedOut: You will enter the simulated identity first.
campaign.notFoundDescription: This campaign is not published in the demo, or the link is wrong.
campaign.metaDescription: {title} by {org}. {rate}, cap {cap} per submission, minimum claim {min}.

signIn.title: Enter the demo
signIn.description: One simulated Google identity owns both the creator workspace and the merchant org. Operations identities live in the demo tools.
signIn.simulatedLabel: Simulated identity · no Google request is made
signIn.noOtherMethod: There is no email, password or one-time code sign-in anywhere in this demo.
signIn.nextNote: After signing in you continue to {path}.
signIn.signedInToast: Signed in as the simulated demo user.
signIn.alreadySignedIn: You are already in the simulated identity.
